description: Every public contract fixture, what single property it exercises, and for hostile fixtures the exact rejection an implementation must produce. The rejection is named as a stable code plus a JSON Pointer so 'rejected' and 'rejected for the right reason' are distinguishable; an implementation that rejects everything passes neither.

canonicalisation.manifest_digest: sha256 over the canonical JSON form of the bundle document with the manifest_digest member removed.
canonicalisation.canonical_json: json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) encoded UTF-8: sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace, non-ASCII escaped. The same convention as app.domain.schemas._Base.content_hash.
canonicalisation.artifact_digest: sha256 over the artifact's exact bytes.
canonicalisation.jobspec_digest: sha256 over the JobSpec bytes as Agent-workbench serialised them.

materialisation: Fixtures are JSON documents. Where a hostile property needs real bytes on disk -- traversal, symlink, oversize, an undeclared entry -- the bytes are described declaratively under each fixture's 'materialisation' key rather than committed. Building the archive is the intake workstream's job; contracts/README.md states exactly how.

fixtures.expected_rejection_reason: candidate_artifacts[3].size_bytes exceeds the 1048576-byte ceiling; an unbounded bundle is an unbounded read and a denial-of-service vector.

materialisation.note: No 2 GiB file is committed. Materialise by generating the declared number of bytes at extraction time; the recorded sha256 is a placeholder because the size ceiling is refused before anything is read.

fixtures.property_exercised: Narrative text carrying prompt injection, template and shell injection, a traversal string, a forged verifier verdict, a NUL byte and a right-to-left override.
fixtures.expected_rejection_reason: narrative.reviewer_note contains characters outside the permitted set (a U+0000 NUL and a U+202E right-to-left override); text that cannot be shown faithfully to a human reviewer is refused at the boundary. The injection strings themselves are retained, not filtered -- they are recorded evidence with no authority over control flow.

fixtures.property_exercised: An outcome record whose verifier attestation is bound to a different bundle's manifest digest.
fixtures.expected_rejection_reason: verifier_attestation.bound_manifest_digest does not equal bundle_manifest_digest; the attestation is not bound to this run's digests, which is a mismatch rather than a pass.

materialisation.note: The attestation names a manifest digest for a different bundle. Every other binding in this record is correct, so only the mismatch fires.
